scope: Pre-rollover additive preparation for WAS-SF after the official NFL game center reported FINAL. The exact final, frozen pre-kickoff rating/H4 snapshot, official final inactive inventories, reusable pregame contribution bindings and literal injury reporting are preserved under Week 6 with the actual recording time. The pair remains blocked pending the official final gamebook and complete paired game-day reconciliation. This does not advance the active manifest, publish ratings, write current-week personnel/QB overlays, construct fairs or issue a bet.

sources.finding: The official NFL game center reports Washington 17, San Francisco 23, FINAL in regulation. At recording time it did not expose a Download Game Book link.

NFL.com's final inactive report lists Washington players Marcus Mariota, Fabian Moreau, Isaac Yiadom, T.J. Maguranyanga, Tanoa Togiai and Charles Omenihu inactive, and San Francisco players Kurtis Rourke, Enrique Cruz Jr., Deebo Samuel, Garret Wallow, Marques Sigle, Nick Bosa and Naquan Jones inactive.

San Francisco's official pregame report states Mike Evans, Gracen Halton, Mykel Williams, Siran Neal and Upton Stout were active; Christian Kirk was ruled out; and Kyle Juszczyk was set to return. This supplies activation context only and does not by itself certify final roles or participation.

NFL.com reports Terry McLaurin suffered a left-knee injury late in the first quarter, was carted off after an air cast was applied, and was quickly ruled out. Postgame concern and pending scans are not converted into an unsupported diagnosis.

NFL.com's league roundup states Mike Evans aggravated his Achilles injury and was ruled out during the game. It also records the postgame statement that no further testing was required and that the coach was hopeful for Week 7; hope is not treated as a return or a final role finding.
The Washington Post reports Javon Kinlaw suffered a knee injury on Christian McCaffrey's second-quarter touchdown and was ruled out for the remainder of the game.

NFL support says final gamebook PDFs are exposed from game centers. At recording time, the WAS-SF game center reported FINAL but did not expose a Download Game Book link, so complete final participation and printed injury/return sequences could not yet be source-bound.

activationFindings.finding: Officially active; active status alone does not establish full participation or eliminate injury loss. Final role review remains required.
Official pregame report says set to return; this is not promoted to a complete historical return until final participation and role are reviewed.
Official team report says ruled out; the league inactive inventory does not list him, so roster/transaction status and any continuing reserve-list treatment remain to be reconciled literally.

WAS.finding: Official final reporting establishes Jayden Daniels completed the game, but the gamebook is required to certify every quarterback appearance and any injury-driven relief interval. Marcus Mariota's inactive status is preserved without inferring a starter loss.

SF.finding: Official final reporting establishes Brock Purdy completed the game, but the gamebook is required to certify every quarterback appearance and any injury-driven relief interval. Kurtis Rourke's inactive status is preserved without inferring a starter loss.

blockers.finding: The official final gamebook PDF was not exposed from the NFL WAS-SF game center at recording time. Complete starter/substitute/DNP participation and all printed injury and return sequences therefore cannot yet be certified.
blockers.nextAction: Retrieve the official final gamebook when exposed; bind its immutable URL and literal participation/injury timeline without backdating this attempt.

blockers.finding: The final inactive lists, activation findings and saved current-week contribution bindings are available, but every inactive, DNP and continuing reserve-list case has not yet been assembled into complete paired historical team coverage. Saved current-week contributions are reusable inputs, not automatic historical adoption, and missing values are not treated as zero.
blockers.nextAction: After the gamebook is available, bind every final inactive/DNP and reserve-list case to the frozen registry, revalidate activation and final game-day role, reserve every added duty once, and run offensive-line, defensive-line, linebacker, defensive-back, receiver and special-teams safeguards.

blockers.finding: Source-bound reporting establishes Terry McLaurin's first-quarter left-knee rule-out, Javon Kinlaw's second-quarter knee rule-out and Mike Evans' second-quarter Achilles-aggravation rule-out. Exact play intervals and complete additional-duty replacements remain unreconciled. A rule-out or non-return is not rewritten as a whole-game loss, and postgame hope for Evans' Week 7 availability is not a return in this game.
blockers.nextAction: Use the official gamebook and source-bound injury timeline to bind each departure, any explicit return or the open interval through game end, and disjoint replacement duties; do not duplicate a whole-game inactive loss.
